checks.name: Default session list works without opening review tools
Revoke cancel preserves both sessions; confirm removes only selected ID
Reenter session list after Home keeps revocation
Default password mismatch stays local; correcting it changes shared preview credential
Old current password is rejected on next change; no stale receipt success
Switching password to sessions clears old error and scroll context
Logout invalidates current session; old password fails and new password logs in via P01
New login retains account credential and prior remote revocation
Explicit disconnected scenario has scoped message; normal preview recovers without account reset
No secret is persisted to browser storage, history or visible review metadata
